paragraphs: In the morning, receive bicycles and ask owners about the problems before diagnosing them; remove wheels, true rims, and replace parts. At midday, perform maintenance by cleaning and lubricating drivetrains. In the afternoon, install customization parts and tune brake feel. Conduct test rides to find issues and make several rounds of adjustments. Before leaving, organize the workstation and parts for the next day.
